title: Psychology and sociology for medicine
purpose: Explain sensation and perception, learning, memory, cognition and language, consciousness and sleep, emotion and stress, motivation and personality, psychological disorders, social psychology, identity, social structure, demographics, and how inequality affects health.

blocks.deliverable: Explain signal detection and classical and operant conditioning with health examples.
Design a study plan using spaced retrieval.
Explain the stress response and its health effects.
Week 7 midterm; compare theories of motivation in health behavior.
Explain conformity and attribution errors in clinical settings.
Explain three social determinants of health with data.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Social determinants analysis: compare the health outcomes of two supplied neighborhoods and explain the likely mechanisms and their limits.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
